text:
alex: quick heads-up — noticed mismatch in API ref for POST /v1/generate. cURL example uses `temperature` and `max_tokens` but runtime expects `temp` and `max_output_tokens`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421

maria: ah thanks, saw that in the review. the schema file under specs/openapi.yaml still has old keys. i'll update the schema and regenerate examples. gonna push a commit in a few.

sam: FYI the python SDK mapping is: Model.generate(temp=..., max_output_tokens=...). older example shows `client.generate(max_tokens=..)` which will break. adding a python snippet to PR.

jonathan: also the example response omits the `usage` object (total_tokens/ prompt_tokens). telemetry changes last week added `usage`. docs should include it, and our sample code for token billing relies on that.

maria: good catch. i'll add a note in the response schema block and update the example response. also will switch the curl example to use application/json and explicit content-type and show streaming vs non-streaming variations.

alex: can we make sure the code fences show inline `model` param too? current example hardcodes `gpt-neo` which we deprecated.

sam: new python snippet (will paste in PR):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
resp = c.generate(model="redwood-1", temp=0.7, max_output_tokens=512, input="Summarize this")
print(resp.choices[0].text)
print(resp.usage.total_tokens)
```

maria: perfect. i'll also add a curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","temp":0.7,"max_output_tokens":512,"input":"Summarize this"}'
```

docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-421--docs.redwood.ai/reference/generate

jonathan: quick nit — response example should include `metadata.language` field now. otherwise examples in other pages will be inconsistent.

maria: adding metadata.language and usage. pushing commit now. assigning @sam for SDK snippet QA and @alex for final docs approval :eyes:

alex: will review post-commit. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
